items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...piano player is Norman Simmons... [INTERVIEWEE] It’s not Howard Alden right now is it?

ctx.x: But he’s later on. I’m talking about before. I’ll go to Freddie Green, that was a big name. And he gave Basie’s rhythm section a special sound. Very important. But I’m going to go back to the roots and see who were the first. Because all of the blues players played guitar. That’s where that came from.

Joe has a fine group right now of musicians he usually works with, which includes a young guitarist that — let’s see his piano player is Norman Simmons, and let’s see if I can remember the guitar player.
It’s not Howard Alden right now is it?
